body_en: Space, medicine, and clean energy show how science serves people. Read one short science news piece a week and summarize it. Note numbers and units carefully. Ask: who benefits, and what risks remain?
body_zh: 航天、医学、清洁能源显示科学如何服务人。每周读一则短科学新闻并概括。仔细记下数字与单位。追问：谁受益，还剩什么风险？
